name: creations_finalize_upload
title: Finalize Upload
description: Step 2 after PUT from `creations_request_upload`: convert temp path(s) to creations. Pass the original source `fileName` (optional) so the creation is born with the user's file name instead of nameless. SVG <=10MB, raster images <=25MB, audio <=50MB, videos <=200MB.

fileName.description: Optional original source file name (may include a path; the server keeps only the base name). Names the creation, e.g. `lola-bonfire.png`.
Optional original source file name for this upload (may include a path; the server keeps only the base name).

visible.description: Show the upload in the user's library. Default true; pass false for a throwaway working asset.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project. Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
